messages:
rachel.bell: FYI spotted a 404 in canary: image at /docs-img/ops/throughput-heatmap.png failing to load when previewing the throughput runbook :eyes:
docs-ci-bot: automated-scan: 404 detected at /docs-img/ops/throughput-heatmap.png (scan id 55001)
marta.gonzalez: thanks Rachel. staging link? can you paste a quick curl so I can repro?
rachel.bell: staging: https://staging.redwood.inference/runbooks/throughput
repro:
```
$ curl -I https://staging.redwood.inference/runbooks/throughput
HTTP/2 200
content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8
...
GET /docs-img/ops/throughput-heatmap.png -> 404 Not Found
```
oliver.nguyen: my guess is this is a leftover from last month's assets reorg. CODEOWNERS points at @docs-assets. For a tiny fix we usually rehost the file under /static/ops and update the markdown link, canary first.
marta.gonzalez: I can take it. Plan: 1) copy s3://docs-legacy/throughput-heatmap.png -> docs/static/ops/throughput-heatmap.png 2) update markdown to /static/ops/throughput-heatmap.png 3) add caption for search: "Throughput heatmap — request distribution" 4) open PR to canary and run preview.
rachel.bell: please also add a short changelog entry and run `scripts/preview --canary` before merging. tiny nit: alt text should be descriptive for accessibility.
marta.gonzalez: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/11011  moved asset + updated link + alt/caption. requesting review: @oliver.nguyen @rachel.bell
oliver.nguyen: quick review done. suggested alt: "Throughput heatmap — request distribution over time". lgtm after CI.
docs-ci-bot: re-scan complete: /static/ops/throughput-heatmap.png reachable (scan id 55002) :white_check_mark:
rachel.bell: great, thanks. I'll add a short task to the docs-sprint board to grep for any remaining /docs-img/ occurrences and add a small docs-ci lint to prevent regressions.
